integrity_notes: Finite enumeration checks support, but do not replace, the all-parameter combinatorial proof. Earlier equivalent specializations cannot be ruled out by search alone.
scientific_limitations: Exact population covariance for uniformly random spanning trees of unweighted simple theta graphs with all three path lengths at least two; no arbitrary-graph or finite-sample reconstruction assertion.
title: Degree covariance detects every edge of a three-path theta graph
